name: SplicerDeviceAction
declaration:
enum SplicerDeviceAction {
  userInfo = 'user-info', // 用户信息
  clearUserInfo = 'clear-user-info', // session清除用户
  updateLang = 'update-lang', // 切换语言
  updateRoute = 'update-route', // 切换路由
  checking = 'device-checking', // 设备自检
  upgrade = 'device-upgrade', // 设备升级
  tokenExpired = 'token-expired', // token过期
  testPattern = 'test-pattern', // 测试画面
  screenBrightness = 'screen-brightness', // 屏幕亮度
  updateDepth = 'update-depth', // 位深
  changeDeliveryMode = 'change-delivery-mode', // 交付模式
}
